method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text from the seat of the individual to whom the Act is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18; seat-neutral core modules in the Act's own actors and terms, regulative rules where the text states a duty, a permission or a deadline, and a seat module of @export questions that calls them. No REFUSE: a gap answers `not covered` with the reason, asserted. Checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: 42 U.S.C. chapter 7 (Social Security Act), OLRC USLM release point Public Law 119-121 (current through 2026-10-09, retrieved 2026-10-19), as deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/usc42-ch7-schII.txt (Title II), usc42-ch7-schXVI.txt (Title XVI) and usc42-ch7-schXVIII-eligibility.txt (ss 1395c-1395r). Figures for calendar year 2026 from fr-2025-19763-ssa-cola-2026.txt (90 FR 49047) and fr-2025-20251-cms-part-b-2026.txt (90 FR 52063), recorded in ../../registers/annual-figures.json; no other year.

checks.result: 224 assertions written, 224 satisfied (83 + 66 + 75), 0 errors, 0 warnings (2026-10-24); 4 #TRACE runs of breached regulative rules printed DEONTIC BREACHED with the expected party and reason
